objective: Prevent benchmark-scope repair from expanding the frozen Opus 5.5 target by confusing useful target behavior with a particular internal mechanism. Preserve all real family behaviors and benchmark thresholds; require explicit target entailment before a behavioral-contract edge becomes a mandatory family acceptance obligation.

theorem.name: TARGET_BEHAVIOR_NECESSITY_BEFORE_MECHANISM_OBLIGATION
theorem.statement: Let T be a frozen useful target behavior and M a Brain implementation mechanism or behavioral residual contract. M may be sufficient or load-bearing for one implementation of T without being a necessary part of T. Therefore M can be a mandatory Opus-5.5 acceptance obligation only if T explicitly contains M as observable target behavior or an independently verified entailment proves that every admissible realization of T must satisfy the observable consequence represented by M. Registry incidence, historical failure, donor usefulness, or current route choice alone is insufficient.
theorem.corollary: A mandatory proof requirement that is neither explicit target behavior nor a proved necessary observable consequence is target-scope expansion, not conservative acceptance.
theorem.preserves: This rule does not delete any family-level target behavior, benchmark threshold, or already-required observable outcome.

edges.reason: Frozen family requires ambiguous multi-file work and self-checking outcomes, but does not require an independent acceptance-model implementation specifically.
Frozen coding behavior names codebase implementation/debugging/refactoring/review/terminal operation; it does not require a normalized formula/schema calculation graph.

Engineering-drawing-to-CAD-solid reconstruction is not contained in the frozen Advanced Agentic Coding useful-behavior sentence. A coding benchmark may contain such a task without making CAD reconstruction a separate mandatory coding-family behavior.

The family requires high-quality professional work products and multi-stage office-task completion. A particular internal revision-planning mechanism is not itself required if the observable professional-quality outcome is proved.

Evidence synthesis can be a professional-work behavior, but the frozen family sentence does not make that exact synthesis transform mandatory for every represented professional task. Public-bar scope must be audited at observable-task level.

The family requires accurate end-to-end multi-application business workflows. It does not require visual browser grounding specifically; API/tool-mediated realizations remain admissible unless target semantics separately require UI interaction.
The family requires solving difficult expert-level questions with search/code/tools, not a particular long-horizon evidence-controller implementation.
Audience-oriented synthesis is a separate useful capability surface and is not explicit in the frozen expert-question-solving family definition.
Independent acceptance-model construction can improve correctness but is not itself the target behavior of answering expert questions with tools.

The frozen family explicitly includes iterative reasoning and scientific tool use, but does not require this exact query/source/stop controller. Preserve the observable long-horizon scientific-task behavior and audit benchmark coverage directly.

Scientific communication/synthesis may be a distinct useful surface, but the current family sentence requires solving long-horizon research/technical tasks and does not by itself prove this exact audience-synthesis transform mandatory.

The frozen family explicitly requires browser/arbitrary-application workflows with visual grounding and judgment; state-conditioned grounded action is an observable necessary component of that stated scope.
